description.en: RoboWits is a bi-manual robotic benchmark designed to evaluate cognitive reasoning, creative tool use, and robustness to unexpected conditions. It includes 30 seed tasks and 208 mutated tasks with graded difficulty across geometry, material, and assembly-based reasoning.
